mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bt_ai_mcp ( id, space_id, bot_id, mcp_id, created_time, status_cd, updated_time, creator_id, updator_id, remark ) VALUES ( #{dto.id}, #{dto.spaceId}, #{dto.botId}, #{dto.mcpId}, , #{dto.statusCd}, , #{dto.creatorId}, #{dto.updatorId}, #{dto.remark} )
mapper.select:
SELECT a.server_id, a.server_name, a.server_desc, a.server_type, a.server_effect, a.server_icon, a.catalog_item_id, a.created_time, a.updated_time, a.creator_id,a.tenant_id, u.user_name AS "creatorCode", CASE WHEN a.tenant_id = -1 THEN '平台' ELSE u.real_name END AS "creatorName", CASE WHEN m.mcp_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS enable FROM bt_mcp_server a LEFT JOIN bt_user u ON u.user_id = a.creator_id LEFT JOIN bt_ai_mcp m ON a.server_id = m.mcp_id AND m.space_id = #{query.spaceId} AND m.bot_id = #{query.botId} AND m.creator_id = #{query.userId} AND m.status_cd = '00A' WHERE 1=1 AND a.status_cd = '00A'
AND a.server_name LIKE
#{query.searchContent}
AND m.mcp_id IS NOT NULL
AND m.mcp_id IS NULL
AND ((a.tenant_id = #{query.spaceId} AND a.creator_id = #{query.userId} AND a.data_from = '10A') OR (a.tenant_id=-1 and a.data_from IS NULL)) ORDER BY a.updated_time DESC
